artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan transcribing the research dispatch's verified probe into the live tree: context-indexed enumeration, consequence-form carrier normalization, generalized compression theorem, the direct-route criterion and procedure, the reduction-route corollary, and documentation reconciliation with the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: When a research dispatch delivers a compiled probe artifact (a namespaced, out-of-build .lean file whose declarations already elaborate sorry-free with measured axioms), the plan phase changes character entirely: approach selection is already settled, and the plan's real work becomes siting decisions (which module each declaration lands in, without widening a subtree's dependency surface), naming decisions (the probe's collision-avoidance suffixes must be renamed on arrival, and repository lint rules such as a no-non-trailing-underscore rule on def names can forbid the probe's own suggested names), and gate-collision scheduling (which generated surfaces the edit moves, and which of those are commit-blocking versus deferrable). Phase decomposition should follow the probe's own dependency order, with one phase per module touched, so each phase is a self-contained transcription whose verification is a single module build.
